full_page.content:
St. Joseph's Hospital Ft. Wayne June 28-1950
Bles'd be God in all His designs. Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
God bless you Miss Panyard - you and yours.
I hope this finds you all well with hopeful outlook. . I want to thank you for your kindness recently received - the writing materials, etc and especially the very nice little "Storm of St. Therese's Glory". I surely find it very interest- ing. This favor came Monday - day before-yesterday. Many thanks too for the beautiful boquet just came in this afternoon.
God bless you. May He speed up your plans and perfect undertakings!
Best wishes and God's blessing to all.
... Fr. Solanus, OFMCap.
